title: CoFiBreak: A Coarse-to-Fine Diversity Reward for Effective Multi-Turn Jailbreak
abstract: arXiv:2610.40926v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated red teaming trains an attacker large language model (LLM) to elicit harmful responses from a victim LLM, but reinforcement learning can collapse attackers onto a narrow set of prompts when attack success is the only reward. Such a collapse of attack diversity can bias safety evaluation toward repeatedly testing near-duplicate attack patterns rather than the underlying harmful intents. Existing methods often trade off attack success or inference cost for greater content or strategy diversity. We propose CoFiBreak, a coarse-to-fine diversity reward for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that improves attack diversity while preserving strong attack effectiveness and low inference cost. translated_title: CoFiBreak：一种用于有效多轮越狱的由粗到细多样性奖励
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.40926v1 公告类型：新论文。摘要：自动化红队测试通过训练一个攻击者大语言模型（LLM）来诱导受害者大语言模型产生有害回应，但当攻击成功率是唯一奖励时，强化学习会使攻击者模型坍缩到狭窄的一组提示词上。这种攻击多样性的坍缩会使安全评估偏向于反复测试近乎重复的攻击模式，而非测试底层的有害意图。现有方法通常以牺牲攻击成功率或推理成本为代价来换取更大的内容或策略多样性。我们提出了CoFiBreak，一种面向组相对策略优化（GRPO）的由粗到细多样性奖励，它在保持强大攻击效果和低推理成本的同时提升了攻击多样性。粗粒度奖励通过鼓励每个GRPO组内代表性不足的策略来拓宽攻击者所使用的策略范围，而细粒度奖励通过阻止重复使用相同的人物角色、叙述框架等方式，拓宽了这些策略的具体实现方式。
tldr: 提出CoFiBreak，一种面向GRPO的由粗到细多样性奖励机制，在保持高攻击效果与低推理成本的同时，显著提升了多轮越狱攻击的策略与实现多样性。
en_tdlr: CoFiBreak introduces a coarse-to-fine diversity reward for GRPO that significantly enhances attack diversity in multi-turn jailbreaking while preserving strong attack effectiveness and low inference cost.
